shrinkage.ts_rule: Shrunk TS% = (2·2PA·shrunk 2P% + 3·3PA·shrunk 3P% + FTA·shrunk FT%) / (2·(FGA + 0.44·FTA)), with the player's own attempt mix.

player.selection_rule: Default example: the 2025-26 player with 25 to 100 three-point attempts whose 3P% moves most under shrinkage (a selection rule to show the method, not a judgement of the player).
